summary: EPFO File Check pre-upload feature on /challans tested end-to-end via UI + backend. Backend GET /api/admin/challans/ecr-check re-verified for run_id csrun_b0e0aaa8c5a6: skip_missing=0 → ok:false, 55 members, UAN check fails ('55 member(s) WITHOUT UAN'); skip_missing=1 → ok:true, 0 members, 55 skipped, UAN check downgraded to warn ('REMOVED from the file'). All 8 checks (file name, UAN present/format/duplicates, member names, RFE-37 contribution formula, EPS/EDLI limits, NCP days) render with correct emoji status (✅/⚠️/❌). Frontend: logged in as super_admin (via localStorage token injection - see note), navigated to /challans, selected csrun_b0e0aaa8c5a6 in portal-run-select dropdown, clicked purple 'EPFO File Check' (data-testid=ecr-file-check) → red panel appeared with header '✗ FIX BEFORE UPLOADING — ECR_062026.txt · 55 members', 8 checks listed, and 25 member names + '…and 30 more' issue list. Clicked button again → panel hidden ✓. Toggled 'Remove Without UAN / ESIC No. Employees' (data-testid=toggle-skip-missing) ON, clicked File Check again → green panel '✓ READY TO UPLOAD — ECR_062026.txt · 0 members (55 without UAN removed)' with UAN check showing ⚠️ warn. Feature works correctly.

issues: Console warning: 'Invalid style property of "padding". Value is "0 8px" but only single values are supported.' — RN Web style bug from another component, non-blocking for File Check.

action_items: Landing-page 'Admin sign in' → admin-pin-login navigation flow was NOT re-tested here (bypassed via API-driven token injection because previous iterations reported it flaky). Consider verifying manually.

Original state had no `finalized` field. Revert if it interferes with other tests.
Optional: fix RN-web 'padding: 0 8px' shorthand style prop causing repeated console error across the app (not in challans.tsx).

Issue list truncates to 25 with '…and N more' — good.

Backend routes/challans.py ecr_pre_upload_check endpoint returns proper structure (ok, file_name, members, skipped_no_uan, checks[], issues[]) and status codes.
